after.manufacturerDetails:
Custom framebag made-to-order for a perfect fit to your Revel Wayward. Select your fabric, features, and specify your frame size below. 
Choose ECOPAK if using recycled fabrics with a non-toxic FC-free coating is important to you. ECOPAK also contains the largest color selection of fluorocarbon free, recycled fabrics at an economical price. Both use a laminate construction for a durable, lightweight fabric. X-PAC’s direct compition with ECOPAK is their recycled RX-Line. Both ECOPAK and X-PAC’s RX fabrics have the benefit of using a 100% recycled polyester face and fabrics are fluorocarbon-free . Beside specific colors, a large differenciator is that X-PAC’s recycled RX-Line is processed, spun, and laminated in the USA while ECOPAK fabric is processed in Asia.
In general, we offer brighter colors with ECOPAK, and more neutral, earth tones with X-Pac. X-Pac also has more options for heavier weight but higher durability such as their X50 Tactical and standard X50 fabrics. you’re looking for high performance fabrics made to maximize durability while minimizing weight. 
Dyneema and Ultra-200 offer unparalleled strength at ultralight weights. Ultra-400 and Ultra VX-40 are the most durability pack fabrics available for bikepacking. 
Waterproof, durable, laminated fabric with 100% recycled polyester. Every yard of ECOPAK™ uses about 20 plastic bottles and saves one pound of carbon emissions compared to standard fabric. All our ECOPAK fabric uses a fluorocarbon free coating.
X-Pac® laminates allows multiple layers, each with different beneficial properties including the use of 500d CORDURA® for all X50 fabrics. These waterproof, durable, lightweight fabrics are made in eco-friendly facilities in the USA and Germany. 
Our greenest fabric yet. The RX-line is USA-made, 100% climate neutral and contains 100% post-consumer recycled polyester fabric with a FC-free (no fluorocarbon water repellent coating) . The Sea Green VX-21 is made from discarded fishing nets.

X10, X11 Cotton Duck consists of a natural cotton outer face ( Fluorocarbon-free ) with a black X-Ply® inner sandwiched by a waterproof polyester film backing.

All other X50 fabrics feature a 500d CORDURA® face but with their standard recycled polyester X-PLY®
